states.description: The person wakes up, uses phone, and prepares to leave the bedroom.

rules.trigger: Person is switching on the main room light

next.on: Person has come back into the room

states.description: The person dries hair, dresses, and makes the bed.

next.on: Person is heading into the kitchen

states.description: The person eats breakfast and cleans up dishes.

rules.trigger: Person is seated at the dining table resting for a moment after eating
rules.action: Pick up the bowl and place it in the dishwasher.

rules.trigger: Person sets the empty cup down on the table or Person is seated at the dining table resting for a moment after eating
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it in the dishwasher.

rules.trigger: Person is seated at the dining table resting for a moment after eating or Person is gathering the bowl and the cup from the table
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it next to the person.

next.on: Person is pulling a can of coffee from the refrigerator

states.description: The person watches TV and drinks coffee on the sofa.

rules.trigger: Person turns off the TV with the remote or Person has finished the coffee and set the empty can down
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it in the designated storage area.

next.on: Person is turning off the TV with the remote

states.description: The person packs bag, puts on jacket, and leaves the home.
